t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the gnomes run on a cycle with decreasing amounts of mushrooms, so if you recognise the pattern you can maximise your score

vb_textbox.text: there are patterns to the colours of the gnomes, each colour goes up and down with the amount of mushrooms they give you. if you can recognise the pattern of each coloured gnome then you can maximise the amount of mushrooms you collect thus getting a higher bonus. especially try to recognise the pattern of the 5x gnomes.
